objective: Find Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.

description: You've got to help me, <name>! My friend, Ringo left earlier to explore the volcano to the south of here, and he has been gone way too long. I am really worried about him.
Do you think you could find him? Why don't you take my canteen with you -- if you do find Ringo, I'm sure he'll need it!
completion: Oh... I'm so glad someone found me...
